note: Overlay merged by the bench. Adds community slots without replacing the OMP-split ledger.

bricks.name: Extension Manager
bricks.summary: TUI to browse, enable, disable, and install Pi packages. Closest thing to a first-party crate manager.
bricks.notes: Does not replace the pigo bench. Use it after the blueprint is applied.

bricks.name: Composio Apps
bricks.summary: Managed auth + tools for Slack, GitHub, Notion, Gmail and 1000+ apps without standing up one MCP server per vendor.
verify: List available Composio toolkits and authenticate one app.
bricks.notes: Review the Composio runtime. Tools execute remotely with your connected accounts.

bricks.name: Claude Marketplace
bricks.summary: Load Claude Code marketplace plugins — commands, skills, agents, hooks, MCP — onto the Pi plate.
bricks.notes: Agents work better with a subagents brick. MCP servers work better with mcp-adapter. Not a plate replacement.

bricks.name: Intercom
bricks.summary: Mailbox between live Pi sessions so a leader can steer workers without dumping full transcripts.
verify: Open two Pi sessions and send one intercom message.
bricks.notes: ~28k monthly installs. Pairs with a single subagents brick, not three.

bricks.name: Fuzzy Find
bricks.summary: FFF-powered fuzzy file and content search that does not pay bash+fzf tokens every turn.
verify: Fuzzy-open a source file by a partial name.

bricks.name: Piolium Audit
bricks.summary: Multi-phase security audits with specialist sub-agents, isolated windows, and resumable state.
verify: Run a scoped audit on a small fixture repo.
bricks.notes: High context. Do not snap together with two other high-cost orchestration bricks unless you mean it.

bricks.name: SSH Tools
bricks.summary: Toggle /ssh for a host, then ssh_read / ssh_write / ssh_edit / ssh_bash without replacing local tools.
verify: Enable /ssh against a throwaway host and read a remote file.

bricks.name: Session Kit
bricks.summary: jayshah96's 17-extension kit: /sessions, /handoff, notify, files, context, btw, todos, review.
bricks.notes: A curated suite, not a plate fork. Conflicts with standalone todo/review bricks because it already ships them.

bricks.name: Firecrawl
bricks.summary: Scrape, map, and extract sites through Firecrawl when a single page fetch is not enough.
verify: Scrape one public docs page to markdown.
bricks.notes: Complementary to pi-web-access (search) rather than a replacement. Needs a Firecrawl key.

bricks.name: Agent Browser
bricks.summary: Interactive browsing + inline screenshots via the agent-browser CLI. First-class Pi package, not a second MCP stack.
verify: Open a page, screenshot it, read the title.
bricks.notes: Conflicts with the MCP chrome-devtools browser brick. Pick one driver.

bricks.name: BTW Sidequest
bricks.summary: /btw asks a side question without polluting the main transcript. From narumiruna's daily kit.
verify: Run /btw on a question that should not enter history.

bricks.name: Blackbox
bricks.summary: Inspect and explain every tool call in the current session — a flight recorder, not a SaaS tracer.
verify: After a few tool calls, open the blackbox timeline.

altInstall: pi install npm:pi-mcp-adapter  # plus chrome-devtools-mcp in .mcp.json
patches.notes: Prefer the dedicated agent-browser brick if you want a first-class driver. This brick stays as the MCP + chrome-devtools path.
